name_reason: Compliant: data_fd2_ prefix, domain 'string_resource_filename', descriptor 'tai_dat' (the on-disk archive name). The name describes the string's role (a resource-filename literal), which is correct regardless of the archive's contents. No Ghidra address residue (the '_dat' suffix is the file extension, not a hex address). Reflects data type (read-only ASCII filename string).
purpose: Read-only ASCII filename literal "TAI.DAT" passed as the path argument to fd2_load_dat_resource/fopen to open the terrain-overlay sprite archive TAI.DAT.
logic_summary: 8-byte const char[8] holding "TAI.DAT\0". Address-taken (array decays to char*) by 6 combat/spell/skill cinematic routines and consumed as a fopen path. The opened archive is TAI.DAT, the terrain-overlay ("Terrain AI") sprite archive (56 entries) loaded as a pair with BG.DAT and sharing its placeholder entry constant. Dynamic callers index the archive by the tile-attribute (terrain) byte read at the caster position (the same index used for the paired BG.DAT load) and hand the loaded overlay to fd2_play_char_intro_zoom_anim / fd2_play_figani_animation_loop as an extra sprite layer; fd2_play_figani_char_intro_animation is the lone exception, loading the fixed index 3 (character-intro name-banner sprite). The caster's own pose sprite is NOT loaded from here (that is FIGANI.DAT[portrait_id*3]).
element_semantics: ASCII bytes of the NUL-terminated filename "TAI.DAT\0" (0x54 0x41 0x49 0x2E 0x44 0x41 0x54 0x00); consumed byte-wise as a char* path.
comment_original_issue: src comment described TAI.DAT as the 'caster character-base sprite archive' and said it loads 'the caster base sprite ... into the cast-pose resource buffer'. This is inaccurate: it conflates TAI.DAT with FIGANI.DAT. Evidence: (1) dynamic callers index TAI by the tile-attribute (terrain) byte at the caster position (fd2_load_dat_resource(0x52393, ..., tile_attr_byte)), not by a portrait/character id; the actual caster pose sprite is FIGANI.DAT[portrait_id*3]. (2) resource_info/tai.md identifies TAI.DAT as a terrain-overlay / 'Terrain AI' archive (56 entries) BG-paired and sharing BG.DAT's placeholder constant. (3) fd2_play_figani_char_intro_animation loads fixed TAI index 3 = character-intro name-banner sprite. The 6-reader list in the original comment was correct.
notes: Verified via: read_memory 0x52393 = 5441492E44415400 ("TAI.DAT\0", 8B, matches src); get_xrefs_to returned exactly the 6 readers in src (all [DATA] reads, no writers => is_const=true). Decompiled fd2_execute_special_attack_skill, fd2_execute_summon_spell_cast (both index TAI by tile_attr_byte) and fd2_play_figani_char_intro_animation (fixed idx 3, name-banner). Cross-checked resource_info/tai.md (Terrain AI, BG-paired). Ghidra plate previously lived in PRE_COMMENT with stale symbol-name order 'data_string_fd2_resource_filename_tai_dat' and an inaccurate 'animation/cinematic byte-stream payload archive' description; moved corrected plate to PLATE_COMMENT and cleared the stale PRE_COMMENT (per project_ghidra_data_plate_mechanism: data plates belong in PLATE_COMMENT). KB resource_info/tai.md already accurate; no KB drift to patch.
